_comment: Import template for your own BCEMP content. Import this file via Settings > Import Content in the app. You may include 'questions', 'flashcards', or both. 'domain' must be one of the domain ids below. Fields marked optional can be omitted. IDs are auto-generated if omitted.

questions.stem: Your clinical vignette / question stem goes here.
questions.rationale: Explain why the correct answer is right (and ideally why others are wrong).

flashcards.front: Prompt / question side of the card.
